comment: Pinned Arsenal census seed shipped under resources/arsenal by scripts/vendor-arsenal.mjs. Unlike the llama/tools payloads this seed is committed: it is the output of one reviewed runner `arsenal refresh` build, not a downloadable archive, so the database itself is the shipped artifact and this manifest pins its SHA-256. The desktop copies it to <userData>/arsenal/arsenal.db on first run when no index exists there (apps/desktop/src/arsenal-provisioning.ts); the runner's own refresh takes over from that file afterwards. Refresh the census by building a new index with the runner, reviewing it, then running the vendor script with --record-hashes.

seeds.note: Production census recorded 2026-10-31: built by the runner's arsenal refresh from the one pinned source repo (the same repo REDTEAM_ARSENAL_SOURCE_REPO defaults to). The counts are the database's own index_meta entry_count/collection_count, read back by the vendor script when the pin is recorded; unparsed 326 and dupe 11 lines from that build are part of the recorded build, not losses in transit.
